translations.web: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
translations.bsb: After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His presence.
translations.kjv: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
